scene: Wide establishing view of Kiratpur Sahib at first light: the domes and saffron Nishan Sahib of Gurdwara Kiratpur Sahib (Sheesh Mahal) and the streets around it; distant sangat only, never the faces or figures of the ten Gurus, God shown only as light.

name: Gurdwara Bangla Sahib, Delhi
scene: Wide establishing view of Gurdwara Bangla Sahib, Delhi in clear morning light: the gold dome of Gurdwara Bangla Sahib above its sarovar in central Delhi; distant sangat only, never the faces or figures of the ten Gurus, God shown only as light.

name: Chandni Chowk and Gurdwara Sis Ganj
scene: Wide establishing view of Chandni Chowk and Gurdwara Sis Ganj at bright midday: the domes and saffron Nishan Sahib of Gurdwara Sis Ganj Sahib and the streets around it; distant sangat only, never the faces or figures of the ten Gurus, God shown only as light.

name: Anandpur Sahib
scene: Wide establishing view of Anandpur Sahib in golden late-afternoon light: Takht Kesgarh Sahib on its hill with the Shivalik foothills and the forts of Anandpur around it; distant sangat only, never the faces or figures of the ten Gurus, God shown only as light.

name: Sri Harmandir Sahib
scene: Wide establishing view of Sri Harmandir Sahib at dusk, sky turning rose: the gilded Harmandir floating in its pool, the marble parikrama and the Akal Takht facing it across the causeway; distant sangat only, never the faces or figures of the ten Gurus, God shown only as light.

name: Big Sur's Esalen coast
scene: Wide view of Big Sur's cliffs at first light, fog lifting off the Pacific, cypress on the bluff.

name: Rishikesh on the Ganges
scene: Wide view of the Ganges in its green gorge at morning, suspension bridges and temple roofs, mist on the hills.

name: Jung's tower at Bollingen
scene: Wide view of a stone tower on the reedy shore of Lake Zurich in late afternoon, mountains faint beyond.

name: Port-Royal des Champs
scene: Wide view of abbey ruins in a wooded valley south-west of Paris, morning mist, an old orchard.

name: Louguantai, where the Tao Te Ching was written
scene: Wide view of a hilltop Taoist terrace in the Qinling foothills, pines, morning haze.

name: Harmandir Sahib, Amritsar
scene: Wide view of the golden temple floating on its pool at dawn, white marble walkway, pilgrims seen from afar.

name: Mount Sinai
scene: Wide view of Mount Sinai's granite peaks at sunrise from the summit, rose-colored ranges in every direction; God only as light.

name: Mount Fuji summit
scene: Wide view from Fuji's crater rim at sunrise, a sea of clouds lit gold; God only as light.

name: The Iron Gates
scene: The Danube narrowing between towering cliffs at sunrise, a carved Roman plaque on the rock.

name: Mount Olympus
scene: Mount Olympus' rocky summit above clouds at sunrise, Aegean far below.

name: Makhtesh Ramon and the Negev
scene: Vast crater of the Negev under a sky full of stars.

name: Gangotri and Gaumukh
scene: Wide view of a glacier snout below snowy peaks at sunrise.

name: Atacama night sky
scene: Wide view of the Milky Way over salt flats and volcanoes.

name: Iona
scene: Wide view of white sand and turquoise sea at sunrise.

name: Huangshan sea of clouds
scene: Granite pinnacles and pines rising from a sea of cloud at sunrise.

name: Arunachala
scene: Wide view of a sacred hill above a temple town at sunrise.

name: Machu Picchu sunrise
scene: Wide view of terraced ruins on a ridge at sunrise.

name: Northern Lights, Tromsø
scene: Wide view of green aurora over fjords and mountains.

name: Kīlauea
scene: Wide view of a glowing crater at night.

name: Santiago de Compostela
scene: Wide view of a vast granite plaza before a cathedral at sunset.

name: Mount Kailash from Manasarovar
scene: Wide view of a snow peak across a still lake at dawn.

name: Sri Pada (Adam's Peak)
scene: Wide view of a summit at sunrise with its triangular shadow on the clouds below.
